const r = $input.first().json; const money = (n) => 'Rs ' + Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-PK', { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 0 }); const cogs = Number(r.costOfGoodsSold || 0); const grossProfit = Number(r.revenue || 0) - cogs; const topItemsRows = (r.topItems || []).length ? r.topItems.map(t => `${t.name}${t.qty}${money(t.revenue)}${money(t.profit)}`).join('') : 'No sales today.'; const lowStockRows = (r.lowStockItems || []).length ? r.lowStockItems.map(i => `
  • ${i.name} — ${i.stock} left (alert below ${i.lowStock})
    • `).join('') : '
  • None
    • '; const outOfStockRows = (r.outOfStockItems || []).length ? r.outOfStockItems.map(n => `
  • ${n}
    • `).join('') : '
  • None
    • '; const html = `

    AL GHOUS BIRYANI — Daily Sales Report

    ${r.date}

    Revenue${money(r.revenue)}
    Cost of Goods Sold${money(cogs)}
    Gross Profit${money(grossProfit)}
    Sales${r.salesCount}
    — Cash${money(r.cashSales)}
    — Card${money(r.cardSales)}
    — Mobile Wallet${money(r.walletSales)}
    — Credit (Udhaar)${money(r.creditSales)}
    — WhatsApp/Delivery${money(r.deliverySales)}
    Refunds${r.refundsCount} · ${money(r.refundsTotal)}

    Top Items Today

    ${topItemsRows}
    ItemQtyRevenueProfit

    Low Stock

      ${lowStockRows}

    Out of Stock

      ${outOfStockRows}

    Automated nightly sales report — AL GHOUS BIRYANI POS

    `; return [{ json: { date: r.date, subject: `AL GHOUS BIRYANI — Daily Sales Report (${r.date})`, html } }];
